key_evidence: Upregulated at the earliest regeneration stage in A. millepora and recurrently after injury in A. aspera.
lth_use: Positive control for Day 1 and Day 3 wounded vs unwounded margins; test whether heat preserves the acute wound signal.
caveat: AP-1 behavior is transient; LTH Day 1 is about 24 h post-wound, later than Xu stage 1 at 6 h.
primary_sources: Xu 2023; van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol; van de Water 2015 Hydrobiologia

key_evidence: Injury upregulated cJun, with further increase under elevated temperature in one heat x injury experiment.
lth_use: Useful for heat x wound interaction at early timepoints.
caveat: cJun was stable in the 10-day injury time course, so it is less consistent than c-Fos.
primary_sources: van de Water 2015 Hydrobiologia; van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol

source_system: Acropora millepora; Acropora aspera; Turbinaria peltata
key_evidence: JNK and MAPK pathways are enriched or responsive during coral injury; ERK2, MEKK1, and p38 vary across A. aspera injury phases.
lth_use: Score early wound signaling modules; ask whether 31 C shifts timing or magnitude.
caveat: Specific MAPK members can move in different directions by species and timepoint.
primary_sources: Xu 2023; van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol; Ren 2026

source_system: Acropora aspera; Acropora millepora; Acropora meta-analysis
key_evidence: Injury activates TLR/NOD and NF-kB-linked immune genes; mild heat can reduce NF-kB/TRAF6 in injured A. aspera.
lth_use: Test whether heat changes immune signaling while tissue closure still proceeds.
caveat: NF-kB also appears in heat-stress biomarker reviews, so interpret direction by contrast and time.
primary_sources: van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol; van de Water 2015 Hydrobiologia; Xu 2023; Dixon 2020; Molinari 2025

key_evidence: Wnt ligands, Wntless, beta-catenin, and APC show dynamic expression in A. millepora regeneration and coenosarc growth.
lth_use: Score later regeneration and patterning, especially Day 10 wounded 31 C vs 28 C.
caveat: Use Wnt-family/orthogroup scores. Wnt3 specifically is not verified from Xu and should not be singled out without orthology evidence.

source_system: Acropora millepora; Porites lobata; cnidarian review
key_evidence: FGF pathway components and sprouty are dynamic in A. millepora regeneration; FGFR1 appears in fragmentation and biomarker contexts.
lth_use: Score regeneration/growth-factor signaling at Day 10 and in wound time course.
caveat: FGF ligands and receptors are paralog-rich; map to A. pulchra orthologs before naming loci.

source_system: Acropora millepora; Acropora hyacinthus disease; cnidarian review
key_evidence: ADAMTS18-like is upregulated in Acropora regeneration; MMP/Zn-MP recur in stress biomarker and disease/wound-related literature.
lth_use: Score ECM remodeling during wound closure and regeneration.
caveat: Xu supports ADAMTS, not generic MMPs. MMP rows should be treated as family-level support unless A. pulchra orthology is clear.
primary_sources: Xu 2023; Molinari 2025; Acropora hyacinthus white syndrome study

key_evidence: Single-cell regeneration data identify collagen, thrombospondin, heparan sulfate proteoglycan, laminin, DAG1, and SDC1 signaling changes around calicoblasts and gastrodermis.
lth_use: Interpret Day 10 regeneration failure and wound-margin tissue remodeling.
caveat: Cell-type signal may dilute in bulk margin RNA-seq; module scoring is safer than single-gene interpretation.

source_system: Acropora hyacinthus; Acropora heat studies; cnidarian wound context
key_evidence: Heat stress compromises epithelial integrity in A. hyacinthus; cell adhesion is part of frontloaded and dampened heat-response modules.
lth_use: Use as a bridge between heat stress and wound-barrier maintenance.
caveat: Traylor-Knowles is tissue/cellular evidence more than bulk DEG evidence for LTH candidate genes.
primary_sources: Traylor-Knowles 2019; Barshis 2013; Dilworth 2024; Nematostella wound context

key_evidence: scRNA-seq suggests epidermal cells differentiate into calicoblasts during regeneration, with wounded tissue enriched for early calicoblast states.
lth_use: Central test for whether heat blocks skeletal regeneration while tissue closure remains intact.
caveat: Bulk RNA-seq cannot directly count cell states unless marker sets are strong.

key_evidence: Galaxin appears in A. millepora regeneration; Han identifies galaxin2, SAARP, mucin, USOMP, CUB, and acidic skeletal matrix proteins in calicoblast trajectories.
lth_use: Score biomineralization and new-corallite formation at Day 10.
caveat: These are family-level candidates; annotation quality and paralogs matter.

source_system: Acropora muricata; Acropora millepora; heat biomarker reviews
key_evidence: Carbonic anhydrase 2/Ca2 is upregulated in wounded calicoblast/symbiocyte contexts; calcium-ion transport appears in Acropora regeneration GO; SLC transporters recur in biomarker literature.
lth_use: Score calcification and biomineralization response to 31 C.
caveat: SLC4gamma is lab-note support unless mapped and source-verified; do not overstate without orthology.

source_system: Porites lobata; Acropora muricata; Acropora heat-tolerance studies
key_evidence: Fragmentation induces calcium homeostasis disruption, calmodulin, calreticulin, calumenin, calcium ATPase, and phosphoinositide/IP3 signaling; Han links calmodulin, Ca2, and calumenin to biomineralization.
lth_use: Interpret shared injury/stress modules and growth-regeneration allocation.
caveat: Porites microfragmentation is not the same as Acropora apical-tip regeneration.

source_system: Acropora aspera; Acropora muricata; Turbinaria peltata
key_evidence: Wounded epidermal cells express catalase, Cyba, and peroxidasin homologs; heat x injury increases catalase in A. aspera; Turbinaria reports antioxidant peaks during early healing.
lth_use: Score redox burden in wound and heat x wound contrasts.
caveat: Redox genes are general stress markers and not specific to regeneration.

key_evidence: A. aspera injury increased phenoloxidase activity in two phases; transglutaminase and hemolectin frame coagulation and wound sealing.
lth_use: Use as wound-healing support, especially if gene annotations are available.
caveat: Phenoloxidase evidence is activity-based, not always direct transcript evidence.
primary_sources: van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol; Palmer 2011

key_evidence: Injury changes C3, Bf, CTL-2, millectin, HL-2, apextrin, and Tx60; heat also shifts complement/lectin expression.
lth_use: Score immune-effector and symbiosis-establishment modules after injury.
caveat: Individual lectins can move in opposite directions; interpret as family/module behavior.
primary_sources: van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol; van de Water 2015 Hydrobiologia; Seneca 2009

source_system: Acropora aspera; Acropora millepora; Acropora cf. tenuis
key_evidence: Injury and bleaching alter GFP-like and chromoprotein expression; sub-bleaching recovery papers also retain pigment-linked expression signals.
lth_use: Bridge color-card/pigment phenotypes to expression modules.
caveat: Direction differs across stress type, light environment, and recovery stage.
primary_sources: van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol; Bonesso 2017; Seneca 2009; Stick 2025

key_evidence: Ren reports odc1 and rac1 in early tissue healing; PCNA is a lab-planning proliferation marker.
lth_use: Use only as a broad proliferation/cell-cycle module unless A. pulchra annotation is strong.
caveat: PCNA is not verified from Xu and should not be used as a headline coral-regeneration gene without source support.

key_evidence: Han identifies extracellular-space and stress-related genes including Itm2b, procathepsin L, prosaposin, and pregnancy-zone proteins in wounded tissue.
lth_use: Exploratory markers for wounded-tissue remodeling and oxidative protection.
caveat: Specific functional interpretation in corals remains tentative.

source_system: Acropora muricata; Acropora millepora; Porites lobata
key_evidence: Ferritin and transferrin are upregulated in wounded or stress contexts and link iron handling, ROS protection, and symbiosis.
lth_use: Score oxidative-stress and symbiosis-linked repair modules.
caveat: May reflect general stress, symbiont state, or cell composition.

source_system: Acropora muricata; Acropora palmata disease/wound context
key_evidence: Han reports Acsl4 upregulated in wounded symbiocytes; disease/wound transcriptomes identify fatty-acid metabolic processes.
lth_use: Link expression to symbiont density, energy storage, and repair costs.
caveat: Not specific to heat or regeneration by itself.

source_system: Acropora muricata; Porites lobata; Acropora heat studies
key_evidence: Han reports downregulated ribosomal/elongation genes in wounded contexts; fragmentation and heat studies show protein synthesis and turnover shifts.
lth_use: Interpret broad resource-allocation and stress-state modules.
caveat: Often reflects global physiology or cell composition rather than a specific pathway.

source_system: Porites lobata; Acropora muricata; Acropora palmata
key_evidence: Fragmentation can increase energy production genes; Han reports mitochondrial ATP-related shifts; heat transcriptomes often alter mitochondrial and metabolic genes.
lth_use: Test whether 31 C diverts or suppresses energy metabolism during regeneration.
caveat: Metabolic direction depends on stress intensity and whether samples capture damage or recovery.

source_system: Acropora hyacinthus; Acropora nana; Acropora palmata; Acropora cf. tenuis
key_evidence: HSP70 is frontloaded in tolerant A. hyacinthus; HSP75 appears in acclimation-associated expression; HSPs are acute heat-response genes in classic heat studies.
lth_use: Score proteostasis but do not require upregulation after chronic exposure.
caveat: HSP induction is time-sensitive and may be absent or dampened after acclimation.
primary_sources: Barshis 2013; Bay and Palumbi 2015; DeSalvo 2010; Stick 2025; Louis 2017

source_system: Acropora aspera; Acropora muricata; Porites lobata; Acropora downingi
key_evidence: HSP90/HSP40/DnaJ/HSP97 respond in fragmentation, regeneration, or targeted heat-biomarker studies.
lth_use: Score ER/proteostasis modules in heat and wound contrasts.
caveat: Older README omitted HSP90 from some sources because Barshis/Bay did not emphasize it; other coral studies do support it.

source_system: Acropora hyacinthus; Pocillopora acuta; biomarker reviews
key_evidence: Small HSPs respond to heat in several coral studies and are included in biomarker reviews.
lth_use: Use as acute or recovery-state markers, not sole heat evidence.
caveat: Small HSPs may be lower in tolerant/frontloaded states or vary by sampling time.

key_evidence: CRISPR-induced HSF1 mutations reduce thermal tolerance in A. millepora larvae.
lth_use: Prioritize as functional heat-tolerance regulator and upstream proteostasis candidate.
caveat: Larval functional validation does not prove adult margin expression effect.

source_system: Acropora nana; Acropora heat-tolerance studies; Porites lobata
key_evidence: Ubiquitin/RING genes occur in acclimation and heat response; fragmentation activates ubiquitin-associated degradation.
lth_use: Score proteostasis and damaged-protein turnover modules.
caveat: Protein turnover responds to many stressors, including injury alone.
primary_sources: Bay and Palumbi 2015; Dixon 2015; Lock 2022; DeSalvo 2010

key_evidence: Redox genes recur in heat, bleaching, fragmentation, natural variation, and heat x injury studies.
lth_use: Primary process score for chronic heat stress and heat x wound costs.
caveat: Redox signal is expected but not specific to one mechanism.
primary_sources: Barshis 2013; Seneca 2009; Bonesso 2017; Lock 2022; Granados-Cifuentes 2013; Louis 2017; Molinari 2025

source_system: Acropora hyacinthus; Acropora palmata; Acropora muricata; Acropora downingi
key_evidence: Thermal stress and frontloading studies highlight TNF/TRAF/apoptosis genes; Han reports Bcl2-related calicoblast patterns; targeted A. downingi work includes Bcl2.
lth_use: Interpret tissue loss, stress tolerance, and repair vs cell-death decisions.
caveat: Bcl2 targeted-qPCR support is recent and lower priority; avoid single-gene overclaiming.

gene_or_family: Acropora environmental stress response type A/type B
key_evidence: A meta-analysis of more than 600 Acropora expression profiles found high-intensity stress and lower-intensity stress can produce different and sometimes opposite expression states.
lth_use: Guardrail for interpreting 31 C as chronic/sublethal rather than acute bleaching.
caveat: This is module/process guidance, not a candidate-gene list for direct testing.

key_evidence: Tolerant or better-performing genotypes/populations can show elevated baseline expression of stress-related modules and smaller induced responses.
lth_use: Test source C vs A/D as a sustained-state or dampened-response hypothesis, not a Day 0 baseline claim.
caveat: LTH lacks true Day 0 expression in the 144-library design.

gene_or_family: Muted acute heat response after acclimation or priming
key_evidence: Short acclimation or heat priming can reduce the magnitude of later heat-induced expression response.
lth_use: Interpret absence of a strong HSP/ESR spike as possible acclimation/dampening.
caveat: Requires careful timing; dampening is not the same as no stress.
primary_sources: Bay and Palumbi 2015; Stick et al. 2026

source_system: Acropora gemmifera; Acropora hyacinthus; Acropora cf. tenuis
key_evidence: Transcriptome recovery speed and module trajectories are linked to bleaching severity, recurrent-bleaching vulnerability, and symbiont shifts.
lth_use: Use WGCNA/module eigengenes against PAM, color, symbionts, growth, and source-thicket sensitivity.
caveat: LTH has no pre-heat baseline in the current 144 libraries; recovery language must be cautious.

key_evidence: Natural gene-expression variation is high among colonies even under common conditions, including stress-related genes.
lth_use: Guardrail for source-thicket interpretation and replication needs.
caveat: Variation may not align cleanly with simple genotypes or phenotype groups.

source_system: Acropora millepora; Acropora aspera; cnidarian review
key_evidence: Lectins respond during bleaching, injury, and heat x injury, and recur in biomarker reviews.
lth_use: Link expression to symbiont-density loss and new-tissue symbiosis establishment.
caveat: Different lectins have different directions and functions; do not collapse all lectins into one gene.
primary_sources: Seneca 2009; van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol; van de Water 2015 Hydrobiologia; Molinari 2025

source_system: Acropora millepora; Acropora aspera; Acropora cf. tenuis
key_evidence: Bleaching, injury, and recovery studies report shifts in chromoprotein or GFP-like genes/proteins.
lth_use: Compare host expression modules with color-card and visual paling results.
caveat: Strongly affected by light, species, pigment class, and recovery stage.
primary_sources: Seneca 2009; van de Water 2015 Mol Ecol; Bonesso 2017; Stick 2025

key_evidence: Ion and solute transporters are linked to heat tolerance, biomarkers, calcification, and symbiosis-related stress responses.
lth_use: Score heat and calcification/symbiosis modules.
caveat: Transporter families are large; orthology and annotation confidence are essential.
primary_sources: Dixon 2015; Louis 2017; Molinari 2025; DeSalvo 2010; Selmoni et al. 2025/2026

key_evidence: Recent Acropora genomic association work links heat-adaptation windows to inositol and glutamate receptor functions; fragmentation work links phosphoinositide signaling to calcium homeostasis.
lth_use: Use as exploratory bridge among heat, symbiosis, and calcium handling.
caveat: Genomic association is indirect and needs expression/orthology support in LTH.

source_system: Acropora palmata; Turbinaria peltata; Acropora cf. tenuis; Porites lobata
key_evidence: Heat and wound studies repeatedly implicate cytoskeleton and ECM/cell-adhesion remodeling.
lth_use: Interpret tissue integrity, margin movement, and regeneration failure.
caveat: Actin is often a housekeeping or normalization gene in qPCR; do not assume all actin changes are biological without RNA-seq QC.

key_evidence: Classic Acropora heat transcriptomics include growth arrest, chaperone activity, nucleic-acid stabilization/repair, damaged-macromolecule removal, and oxidative-stress transcription factors.
lth_use: Use as exploratory annotation categories for heat DE and enrichment.
caveat: Older microarray studies have limited annotation and platform comparability.

gene_or_family: Host stress genes plus symbiont fraction/expression
key_evidence: Bleaching and transcriptomic-recovery studies emphasize host expression, symbiont density/type, and symbiont read mapping as linked but distinct layers.
lth_use: Analyze host-only and symbiont-aware outputs separately when mapping allows.
caveat: Do not let variable host:symbiont RNA fraction masquerade as host gene expression without QC.

key_evidence: Global Acropora genomic vulnerability analysis found overlapping heat-adaptation windows enriched for heat-shock protein binding and unfolded-protein binding, including HSP70 and protein-folding candidates.
lth_use: Use as orthology-aware follow-up after the A. pulchra annotation is fixed.
caveat: GEA evidence is not expression evidence in LTH and can include false positives.

key_evidence: A 2025 synthesis found seven genes with consistent heat responses across at least two cnidarian genera and proposed a cBATS-style panel.
lth_use: Use as a compact sensitivity panel after genome-wide analysis.
caveat: Review-level panel; test in LTH rather than assuming universality.

key_evidence: The 2017 biomarker review highlights promising host and symbiont thermal-stress GEBs while emphasizing that no universal biomarker exists.
lth_use: Use as supporting sensitivity panel and annotation cross-check.
caveat: Review emphasizes variability across setups, colonies, symbionts, diel cycles, thresholds, and histories.

key_evidence: These names appear in lab planning documents or older candidate panels, but support is incomplete or contradicted for coral regeneration.
lth_use: Keep visible so they can be checked, not silently promoted.
caveat: Xu supports Wnt-family involvement but not Wnt3 specifically; Xu argues against TGF-beta involvement in coral regeneration; PCNA needs a verified coral source.
primary_sources: Lab NSF Aim 2 notes; Keck signaling notes; Xu 2023 for contradiction
